next.reason: 1985: GENERATE data-name-1 performs detail processing and 'Normally' presents the designated detail. 2023: §2023:14.9.16.4 GR1 'causes one instance of the specified detail to be printed', following control break and page fit processing; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR4 d) and GR5 b) 'The specified detail is printed, unless summary reporting is specified'; §2023:13.18.57.4 GR5 'Detail report groups are printed when referenced explicitly in a GENERATE statement' and GR6 d). The 1985 'Normally' is SUPPRESS in a USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure, kept by §2023:14.9.45.4 GR3 a) 'The printing of the print lines of the report group'. Same effect.
